parsed.explanation: No criminalisation, entry, detention or custody exposure is documented, and hate-crime/hate-speech law covers transgender identity with functioning courts. This supports Reduced Risk. Deductions follow the operative exposures: a documented pool-chain changing-room ban is a universal facility exposure for visitors using those facilities, minor gender-affirming care is sharply restricted in practice, hate-speech enforcement is contested, and organised political opposition/intimidation is documented. Resident LGR medical barriers are climate only and were not deducted as visitor exposure.

federal_state_facilities.exposure: October 2025: national pool chain stopped trans customers choosing changing rooms; reported as reaching ordinary public facilities, legal scope beyond chain not documented.
federal_state_facilities.protection: Legal contestation reported, outcome not documented.
federal_state_facilities.interaction: Facility rule operates regardless of visitor's home documents; no documented general bathroom ban.

care_services.exposure: 2021-2022: puberty blockers/hormones stopped for under-16s, 16-18 only in approved trials; guidance limits blockers to exceptional cases. Adult visitor continuity not documented.
care_services.protection: Prescriptions rose slightly after 2022 guidance per 2026 data; adult care regime not documented.
care_services.interaction: Mainly affects minors needing continuity; emergency adult care not documented.

threat_framing_law_enforcement.exposure: Organised far-right/Christian-democrat opposition framing trans reform as defence of women/national values; scholars record intimidation of advocates. Authorities declined to prosecute anti-gay imam; preacher acquitted to Supreme Court on religious-speech grounds.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.protection: Transgender identity in hate-crime law since 2018 and hate-speech law since 2019.
threat_framing_law_enforcement.interaction: Protection exists but religious-speech limits and non-prosecution show contested enforcement.

minors_guardians.exposure: LGR from 16 requires doctor/psychologist statement, health-authority approval and guardian consent for 16-17; medical barriers remain. Minor care restriction above applies to travelling minors.
minors_guardians.protection: Age lowered from 18 to 16 from July 2025, simplifying procedure.
minors_guardians.interaction: Resident LGR/minor-care rules signal climate and care access, but visitor uses home documents; care continuity is the traveller-facing issue.

street_violence_police_response.exposure: Political violence/intimidation and online harassment against trans advocates documented; no visitor-specific violence rate or police targeting documented.
street_violence_police_response.protection: Police-recorded LGBTQI hate-crime dataset exists; hate-crime coverage includes transgender identity.
street_violence_police_response.interaction: Dataset captures only police-identified motives, so unrecorded hostility is unknown; absence is not treated as safety.

remedies_unknowns.exposure: Changing-room contestation outcome, conversion-practices bill status, wider facility scope and entry practice not documented.
remedies_unknowns.protection: Supreme Court adjudication and hate-crime law show functioning legal institutions.
remedies_unknowns.interaction: Functioning courts do not cancel the pool facility exposure; no documented remedy has yet reversed it.

anchor_checks.comparison: Higher than 0.55-C: ward placement by document marker across hospitals is broader and more severe than a documented pool-changing-room restriction with no documented hospital, detention or entry analogue.

Slightly lower than 0.75-C: that anchor has brief border detention but working release/compensation; here there is no detention, but a current facility ban plus restricted minor care and contested hate-speech enforcement are operative deductions.

Lower than 0.85-A: that anchor has explicit equality protection, respectful policing and prompt discipline; here changing-room access is unsettled/restricted, minor care is narrowed, and organised opposition is documented.

parsed.synthesis: Combined regime: no documented border, police-detention or custody pathway to imprisonment, with hate-crime protection and functioning courts. The traveller's real exposure is narrower but concrete - exclusion from chosen pool changing rooms, possible interruption of minor gender-affirming care, and a hostile organised political climate with uneven hate-speech enforcement. Those documented exposures place the case below full-protection anchors, while absence of criminalisation/targeting keeps it well above severe-risk anchors.
